item_short_desc: Rothco’s MICH Helmet Goggle Straps are a must-have accessory for anyone using a MICH helmet, designed to keep your goggles securely attached and prevent loss during intense activities. Made from durable denier polyester material, these straps are built to last and withstand daily wear and tear. The snap button attachment makes it easy to fasten the straps to your helmet, ensuring your goggles stay in place even during the most active use.
